name: Runner Extras - FlowField Lookup Unquoted Table
brief: Regression: a lookup() FlowField CalcFormula whose source table name is an unquoted AL identifier (e.g. `lookup(MyTable.Field where(...))`, legal AL — quotes are only required when the name contains spaces) must parse and calculate correctly, not silently resolve to 0.
description: RecordPatches.AlSourceParser.RxCalcFormulaParts required the CalcFormula's source table name to be double-quoted (`lookup("My Table".Field where(...))`); a single-word unquoted table name (`lookup(MyTable.Field where(...))` — legal AL, exactly what Pageworks' PageworksDSFieldMapLine.TargetTableNo declares against PageworksDSFieldConfigLine) silently failed the regex. TryParseCalcFormula returned null, so the field's NCLMetaField.CalculationFormula stayed at NCLMetaCalculationFormula.EmptyFormula, and FlowFieldPatches.RecordImpl_CalcFieldsAsync_3's own EmptyFormula check made CalcFields() a silent no-op — the field stayed at its type default (0) instead of the real looked-up value. Downstream AL code that opens a RecordRef/FieldRef by that now-zero table number then throws 'no NCLMetaTable for table 0' (or a field-not-found style error for other CalcFormula shapes) with no indication the real cause was upstream, in metadata parsing.
